name: Dark Roast Romance
source:
You've been looking for love for a very long time, downloading dating app after dating app, but to no avail. When you manage to get a date from a real person, they stand you up and leave you alone at the last place you'd ever want to be—a cafe. 

Before you can think of going home, an odd man claiming to be a "Wish-Granter" takes a seat at your table...

[From [url=https://himebee.itch.io/dark-roast-romance]itch.io[/url]]
